title: Fix librarian autofix/resolver disambiguation for ROOT-top-level files sharing a stem
description: librarian.py cannot disambiguate a ROOT-top-level markdown file whose stem collides with a nested file. resolve_wikilink() does stem lookup before the path branch and only takes the direct-path branch when the name contains '/'; a top-level file's relative_to(root) has no slash. add_wikilinks_to_related_section() therefore emits the bare ambiguous form (e.g. [[AGENTS]]) for MAP_System/AGENTS.md, which validate then flags. Found while resolving 3 bare [[AGENTS]] backlinks (dora #5380), worked around manually with [[./AGENTS.md]]. Will recur for any future top-level doc sharing a stem. Fix: make the autofixer emit a resolver-accepted disambiguation for top-level files (e.g. './NAME.md' prefix, or detect post-relative-path ambiguity) and/or teach resolve_wikilink to treat a bare top-level stem as unambiguous when an exact ROOT/NAME.md exists. Add a regression test.
acceptance_criteria: A ROOT-top-level file sharing a stem with a nested file (e.g. AGENTS.md) can be linked with a stable form that librarian.py validate accepts as unambiguous, produced by the autofixer without manual editing.
A regression test covers the top-level-stem-collision case for both resolve_wikilink and the related-section autofixer.
